Izumi Seinikuten / Private rooms

Private rooms

On basement level 1 there are six private rooms with doors, walls and sunken floor seating, plus a counter.

Seating

Room for up to 4
5 rooms
Room for up to 6
1 room
Counter (seats for 2)
3 places

Sunken seating (horigotatsu) lets you sit on the floor with your legs down in a recess, so there is no need to kneel.

  • Private rooms can be used by two guests.
  • For 20 or more guests, ask us about booking the whole restaurant.
  • To request a particular room, please ask by phone.

Questions & answers

Do you have private rooms? How many people can they seat?

We have six private rooms with sunken floor seating: five for up to four guests and one for up to six. There are also counter seats for two. For 20 or more guests, ask about booking the whole restaurant.

Can two people use a private room?

Yes. There are also counter seats for two.

Reserve by phone. Same-day tables can be checked, too.

Phone lines open at 16:00. Courses are for two or more guests; table-only reservations are accepted from one guest.
